title: Today's School Lunch
description: Work together as cafeteria staff. Each student becomes an ingredient expert, returns to the team, and completes today's lunch tray before time runs out.

ingredients.name: rice

hints.stage1: It is a grain eaten every day in Korea and many Asian countries.
hints.stage2: It is white or brown and often served in a bowl.
hints.stage3: People steam it and eat it with side dishes.
hints.stage4: Fried rice is made from it.
hints.stage5: It starts with the letter R.

ingredients.cookingHint: Use steamed rice for fried rice.

hints.stage1: It is a fermented Korean side dish with a strong smell.
hints.stage2: It is often red and spicy.
hints.stage3: It is made from cabbage or radish.
hints.stage4: Many Koreans eat it at every meal.
hints.stage5: It starts with the letter K.

hints.stage1: It comes from a chicken and is used in many dishes.
hints.stage2: It has a yellow yolk inside a white part.
hints.stage3: You can fry, boil, or scramble it.
hints.stage4: An omelet is made from it.
hints.stage5: It starts with the letter E.

hints.stage1: It is a long green vegetable used for flavor.
hints.stage3: People chop it and put it on soup or fried rice.
hints.stage4: It smells fresh and a little sharp.
hints.stage5: It has two words and starts with G.

ingredients.name: miso

hints.stage1: It is a Japanese paste made from fermented soybeans.
hints.stage3: It is used to make a famous Japanese soup.
hints.stage4: The soup is often served with tofu.
hints.stage5: It starts with the letter M.

ingredients.cookingHint: Dissolve it in hot water, do not boil too hard.

ingredients.name: tofu

hints.stage1: It is a soft white food made from soybeans.
hints.stage2: It has almost no taste alone.
hints.stage3: It is popular in Korean and Japanese cooking.
hints.stage4: It is often cut into cubes for soup.
hints.stage5: It starts with the letter T.

ingredients.cookingHint: Cut into small cubes for soup.

hints.stage1: It is a dairy product made by fermenting milk.
hints.stage2: It is creamy and often slightly sour.
hints.stage3: People eat it with fruit or as a dessert.
hints.stage4: It is sold in small cups at school lunch.
hints.stage5: It starts with the letter Y.

Take the yogurt from the fridge.
